done_when: Regression tests show commits around UTC midnight are assigned to the correct UTC day; today/yesterday and six-day counts agree with independently parsed commit timestamps; cleanup count uses the same UTC day bounds; status board remains read-only.
goal: Fix status_board commit and cleanup counts so UTC-labeled values use explicit UTC calendar boundaries instead of local time.
scope_out: other dashboard sections, live trading, deployments, secrets
steps: Add failing tests using offset-bearing commit timestamps around UTC midnight and local midnight.
Change git queries/counting to explicit UTC boundaries for today, yesterday, rolling daily output, and cleanup commits.
Run focused status-board tests and independently compare the rendered counts against UTC-parsed commit timestamps.
tests: Add tests first for commits on either side of UTC midnight and local midnight; demonstrate current failure before implementation, then pass after fix.
title: Use UTC day boundaries in status board commit counts
